text: なに　わしには　おきにいりの　とりポケモン　オニドリルが　おる　いきたい　ところへ　ひとっとびじゃ　だから　じてんしゃ　など　いらん！

structure.jp: わしには　おきにいりの　とりポケモン　オニドリルが　おる
structure.en: I have my favorite bird Pokémon, Fearow

structure.jp: いきたい　ところへ　ひとっとびじゃ
structure.en: it's one quick flight to wherever I want to go

structure.jp: だから　じてんしゃ　など　いらん！
structure.en: so I don't need a Bicycle or the like!

patterns.name: 〜には〜がいる
patterns.span: わしには　おきにいりの　とりポケモン　オニドリルが　おる
patterns.explanation: Person には, living thing が いる means that person has it. おる is the old-man form of いる. わしには　オニドリルが　おる = 'I have Fearow'.

patterns.name: 〜たい
patterns.explanation: たい added to a verb means 'want to do', and here the whole thing describes the place after it. いきたい　ところ = 'the place I want to go'.

patterns.name: 〜ない
patterns.explanation: ん in place of ない is the old-man and dialect way of saying 'not'. など before it adds a dismissive 'something like'. じてんしゃ　など　いらん = 'I don't need any Bicycle'.
